contracts:
Notation: objectName : Classifier. Actor names identify user roles. Calls use operation(parameter: Type); replies use result: Type. HTTP/SDK requests use asynchronous call arrows and their completion uses a named dashed reply. Local calculations use synchronous calls. Contract names below group fields for readability; they are documentation aliases, not additional runtime classes.
Credentials = {email: string, password: string}; BaselineTables = {team_df: DataFrame, league_df: DataFrame}; UpliftInputs = {teamRows: DataFrame, rankings: DataFrame}; QualityOptions = {required_columns?: Sequence[str], key_fields?: Sequence[str], row_key?: Sequence[str], seasons?: Sequence[str], teams?: Sequence[str]}. UserRole = coach | analyst | null; null means no assigned role. VerifiedClaims contains sub, exp, aud and iss after signature/issuer/audience/expiry validation. AuthContext = {token: string, role: coach | analyst}; token values are never shown. HttpError = {status: integer, detail: string}. ApiResult<T> = successful body T or HttpError.
DataFilters = {season: string, team?: string, side?: offense | defense, play_type?: string, min_poss: number >= 0, limit: integer 1..2000}; preview defaults limit=200. CSV uses the same filters except limit. TeamPlaytypesPreviewResponse = {season: string, total_rows: integer, returned_rows: integer, rows: TeamPlayRow[]}. TeamPlayRow contains the selected source columns, including PLAY_TYPE, POSS and PPP.
Matchup = {season: string, our: team code, opp: different team code, k: integer 1..10, w_off: number 0..1}. Backend w_def = 1-w_off. ContextInputs adds margin: number, period: integer 1..5, time_remaining: seconds 0..720. Frontend maps timeRemaining to time_remaining. These are the current API limits.
MetaOptions = {seasons: string[], teams: string[], teamNames: map, playTypes: string[], sides: string[], hasMlPredictions: boolean}; frontend fallback adds _fallback=true. BaselineRankResponse = {season, our_team, opp_team, k, w_off, w_def, rankings: records[]}. BaselineRow = {playType, pppPred, pppOff, pppDef, pppGap, rationale, raw}. ContextRankResponse includes matchup, context and rankings; ContextRow = {playType, finalPPP, mlPPP, baselinePPP, deltaPPP, contextLabel, rationale, raw}.
CalibrationRequest = {n_splits: integer 1..10, n_bins: integer 2..20}; panel supplies n_bins=10. CalibrationReport = {model, evaluation, summary, folds[], warnings[]}; summary includes count, mean_predicted_ppp, mean_realized_ppp, bias_ppp, mae_ppp, rmse_ppp, binned_absolute_bias_ppp and bins[]. Each bin includes lower_ppp, upper_ppp, count, nullable means/bias and sparse. UpliftReport includes matchup, requested/actual K, historical seasonal PPP, modeled Top-K PPP, absolute/relative uplift, formulas, units, provenance and rankings[]. These reports describe retrospective evidence, not future forecast accuracy.
CsvDownload = {status: 200, mediaType: text/csv, filename: string, body: UTF-8 bytes}. Credentials and concrete JWT values are intentionally absent. Promise completion returns the named payload; failures reject or return the labeled HTTP error and do not become successful exports.
